purpose: isolate per-task validation model selection vs final-epoch selection in project-adapted TED, not a faithful author reproduction
arms: highest current-site validation foreground micro Dice each epoch; earliest tie
initialization: fresh random per seed, no pretrained model weights
training: site1 then site2, 20 epochs each, batch8; same original project inputs, labels, model, optimizer and objectives; restore selected network and BN before teacher creation
selection_and_evaluation: selection on each current site's full validation every epoch; evaluate site1 and 2 val at end of task2, using foreground micro Dice and predicted/reference foreground rates. Validation reused in selection, hence optimistic, especially current-site; any pass requires independent further validation before test.
qualification: all four arms rc0 finite; average gain over two sites and two seeds >=0.03, each seed mean positive and no site mean decrease >0.02; only permits independent follow-up
limitations: authors' validation metric and exact restore semantics not independently verified; different network, preprocessing, data order and split; GPUs not bitwise paired; results are exploration not unbiased generalization
stop: nonfinite loss, logits, parameters, optimizer or validation, loss >10000, any arm failure, deadline or disk cap; no retries
